jury_question: Who should carry the wait for eviction cases: landlords through a charge, taxpayers through more courts, or should tenants and landlords settle most cases themselves?
jury_options: Landlords pay, through a ring-fenced fee that funds the courts
Taxpayers pay for a separate housing tribunal with its own judges
Local desks steer settlements, paid by a landlord charge
Tenants should not carry any extra cost or risk during the wait
